description: The bar chart illustrates average like counts across five binned ranges shown as interval categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled (0,90], (90,180], (180,270], (270,360], and (360,450], displayed left to right in increasing interval order with rotated tick labels; no explicit x-axis title is shown. The vertical axis is labeled “Avg. Like #” and uses a linear numeric scale with visible tick labels from about 400 up to 600 at regular 50-unit intervals (400, 450, 500, 550, 600), with the plotting area extending slightly above 600. Each category is represented by a single light-blue bar with a thin dark outline and a vertical error bar (black line with caps) centered on the bar top: (0,90] is approximately 600, (90,180] about 567, (180,270] about 572, (270,360] about 595, and (360,450] about 590. The error bars vary in length, with shorter ones on the first two bars and longer ones on the last two bars, and there is no legend, stacking, or grouping beyond the single series; the bars are not additionally emphasized by annotations or special shading.
